title: Assignment from a Block Code
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ variables whose width is at most $w$, and let $B$ be a switching block code of length $w$. The resulting binary assignment is zero outside the support of $T$; on each supported coordinate, it is the sum modulo $2$ of the bit of $B$ at the image of that coordinate’s position in $T$ and the bit encoding the sign required by its literal.
hypotheses_covered: The width of $T$ is at most $w$
A switching block code of length $w
